referenceSources.title: McLaren ingin kembali ke Le Mans | Berita Le Mans
referenceSources.description:
A black McLaren F1 GTR, car number 59, sits in its pit box during the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans. Mechanics in white suits work on the vehicle as photographers and team staff look on from behind the pit wall. Above the garage door, the signs “Mc LAREN 59” and “CALLAWAY 76” mark the team’s bay.

This photograph, sourced from Motorsport.com, illustrates the high-pressure environment of an endurance racing pit stop. The image accompanies an article about McLaren’s plans to return to Le Mans in the LMP1 class under more cost-effective regulations, featuring comments from Zak Brown on the need for rule changes and comparisons to LMP2 and IMSA DPi categories.
